title: Saving the queue can truncate it

promptSteps.prompt: A machine lost power while QueueDesk was saving, and the data file came back half written: the queue was unreadable and the jobs in it were gone. Saving must never leave a partial file behind, whatever happens during the write. DECISIONS.md records how this is meant to work. Please fix the cause, and leave the public suite green. Run `npm test` in the project root to check your work.
